D1_protect_joint_policy.mechanism: ProtectPosterior.components stores only (structure, cross_sign), while probabilities also index reliable in {0,1}; the existing oracle dict collapses the two reliable atoms and retains only the reliable=1 value.
D1_protect_joint_policy.named_disagreeing_factor: partner reliability latent L and its p(L)=0.5 plus partner/support/contact likelihood factors

D2_split_context_slot.mechanism: Every licensed active_contexts=1 structure has finite positive code-length prior mass. In all 1,000 retained worlds the normalized restricted posterior is finite, but exponentiating its very negative log evidence underflows to 0.0 and is misread as empty structural support.
D2_split_context_slot.named_disagreeing_factor: exp(restricted.log_evidence) used as a support-positivity test
